class.name: JRPGMoveRoute
class.brief_description: A movement route: route commands a character follows one after the other.
class.description: Route commands, each an [Array] [lb]code ([enum Code]), arguments...[rb], that [JRPGCharacterMotion] runs one after the other: a page's custom route, or a route Set Movement Route forces on a character. [member repeat] starts the route again at its end; [member skippable] skips a move that is blocked rather than waiting for the way to clear; [member wait] makes Set Movement Route wait until the route has ended. Codes are stable numbers that saved routes hold. The moves, turns, Wait, switches, speed, frequency, direction fix and through work now; the others come with a later version and are skipped with a warning. Authority: server.

method.name: get_arguments
method.description: Returns the arguments of command [param index].

method.name: get_code
method.description: Returns the code of command [param index].

method.name: get_code_name
method.description: Returns the name a route editor lists command [param code] under ("Move Down").

method.name: get_command_count
method.description: Returns how many commands the route holds.

method.name: is_move
method.description: Returns whether command [param code] takes the character a cell (or tries to).

members.member: The commands, each [lb]code, arguments...[rb]. Entries that are not an array starting with a known code are left out, with an error.
The route starts again when it ends.
A move that is blocked is skipped (Skip If Cannot Move); otherwise the route waits for the way to clear.
Set Movement Route waits until the route has ended (Wait for Completion).
